biography:
I’ve spent over 20 years in the energy industry, primarily in DER development and implementation, holding executive roles in Fortune 500 companies, privately held businesses, and venture-backed startups. I’m most recently served as Chief Commercial Officer at Haven Energy, a climate technology company advancing the clean energy transition by scaling the adoption of distributed energy resources in underserved communities. 

Throughout my career, I’ve helped large commercial, industrial, and government organizations reduce their carbon footprint through the sourcing and implementation of renewable energy and energy efficiency assets. Prior to my work at Haven, I was Chief Operating Officer at Sparkfund, Vice President of Sustainable Energy at Eco Engineering and Director of Business Development at Metrus Energy, a market leader in the “Efficiency as a Service” space.

I began my energy career at NRG Energy, where I held various leadership positions, including co-founding the Integrated Solutions Team which was tasked with developing a suite of services to large business customers including EVSE, solar, back-up generation, combined heat and power, demand response, and grid connected electricity supply.

I’m a proud alumnus of Syracuse University, where I earned a BS in Economics. Go Orange!
